THE CELLWEAR STANDARD

The image should invite curiosity. The context should earn trust.

01

Source first

Core medical claims link to established public-health and research institutions.

02

Label the image

Editorial artwork and microscopy-inspired designs are never presented as patient specimens.

03

Teach, don’t diagnose

Articles explain concepts without interpreting personal results or replacing a care team.

04

Keep it current

Each field note carries a publication date and can be revised as trusted guidance changes.
